title: How to Build an SEO Strategy That Compounds
excerpt: A practical framework for keyword clusters, content quality, and technical foundations.
body:
Start With Search Intent

A strong SEO strategy begins with the real questions your customers are already asking. Map topics by intent, priority, and business value before writing a single page.

Build Topic Clusters

Group keywords into pillar pages and supporting articles so Google can understand your authority. Internal links should guide readers from education to action.

Review and Improve

Track rankings, clicks, conversions, and content decay every month. The best SEO systems compound because they are maintained consistently.

title: Meta Ads Testing: What to Change First
excerpt: Simple experiments that reveal better audiences, offers, and creatives.
body:
Test One Variable

Start with the offer, then test creative, audience, and landing page. Changing too much at once hides the lesson.

Watch Cost and Quality

A winning ad is not only cheaper. It should bring qualified leads who actually convert after the click.
